blocks.text: DALLAS— Cooper Flagg scored 33 points, P.J. Washington Jr. added 21 and the Dallas Mavericks stopped a three-game losing streak with a 116-94 victory over the Golden State Warriors in the NBA on Wednesday night. Will Richard scored 18 points and rookie Yaxel Lendeborg had 13 for Golden State, which dropped to 0-4 on a five-game trip that started with Stephen Curry tearing an oblique muscle in a loss to the Houston Rockets. The Warriors have lost by 38, 21 and 22 points in three full games without their superstar, who is expected to miss at least another week. Kyrie Irving […]...
